title: Supervisor
description: M2: the agent and gss-init (PID 1 in every game container). gss-init reads `InitSpec` from a mounted file and serves this protocol on a unix socket; the agent is the only client and may reconnect at any time.

INIT_SPEC_PATH.description: Where gss-init reads its spec (read-only mount).

INIT_FILES_DIR.description: Definition files (hooks, templates) under their definition-relative path, e.g. /gss/spec/files/hooks/install.sh. Hook paths in the spec are relative to this folder.

INIT_SOCKET_PATH.description: The supervisor socket inside the container (the run folder is a read-write mount).

INIT_DATA_PATH.description: The server's data folder inside the container.

INIT_BACKLOG_LINES.description: Console lines kept in gss-init's ring buffer.

INIT_INSTALL_TIMEOUT_SEC.description: Default for `InitSpec.installTimeoutSec`: an install still running after this long is cancelled and ends `install_failed`.

GAME_UID.description: uid and gid the game and every hook run as (`gss` user in ionnet-gss-base).

x-messages.description: Current state. The agent sends it first after every (re)connect.
Run the install steps from the start (first install, retry, reinstall). Answers when install has begun.
Apply configs, run the pre-start hook, launch the game on a pty.
Stop command or signal, SIGKILL after the timeout, then the post-stop hook.
One console line to stdin or rcon.
Lines from the ring buffer between `afterSeq` and `beforeSeq`, capped by count and encoded size (`more` says the answer was cut); how the agent catches up after a restart and how browsers page back.
Re-read the spec file after the agent rewrote it (settings changed). Takes effect at the next start.

InitSpec.description: The file gss-init reads (`INIT_SPEC_PATH`). Fully rendered by the panel.

start.description: Command line, run through `/bin/sh -c` as uid 1000 in /data.

ready.description: null = `running` as soon as the process starts.

env.description: Environment for the game and hooks: `GSS_VAR_<KEY>`, `GSS_PORT_<NAME>`, `GSS_SERVER_ID`.

installTimeoutSec.description: Seconds the whole install may take (the definition's `install_timeout`); 0 or absent = `INIT_INSTALL_TIMEOUT_SEC`.

agentUid.description: Set by the agent, not the panel: uid of the host agent. gss-init gives it the socket (0600) and the run folder (0700), so no other host user can reach the socket. 0 or absent = root.

agentGid.description: Set by the agent: gid of the host agent, for the socket and the run folder.

AutoRestart.description: Restart after a crash, at most `max` times within `windowSec`; beyond that the state stays `crashed`.

pid.description: Game process id inside the container, while it runs.

reason.description: Why the agent stops the game (e.g. over its disk limit): becomes the `reason` of the final `stopped` state.

afterSeq.description: Return lines with a higher `seq`; 0 = from the oldest kept.

beforeSeq.description: Return lines with a lower `seq`; 0 or absent = up to the newest.

limit.description: Most lines to return; 0 = as many as fit `CONSOLE_BATCH_MAX_LINES` and `CONSOLE_BATCH_MAX_BYTES`, which always cap the answer.

tail.description: Which end of the range to keep when not everything fits: true = the newest lines (opening a console, paging back), false = the oldest (catching up after `afterSeq`). `more` in the answer says whether lines were left out.
